summary: Brightline Interactive filed an 8-K on October 14, 2026, disclosing receipt of a Nasdaq letter dated October 12, 2026, confirming regained compliance with Listing Rule 5550(a)(2), the $1.00 minimum bid price requirement, after the closing bid held at or above $1.00 for 10 consecutive business days. Nasdaq had issued a Staff Determination to delist on September 11, 2026; the Company timely requested a Hearings Panel review on September 17, 2026, staying suspension, then effected a 1-for-8 reverse stock split effective September 28, 2026. No price, advisor, or board recommendation was stated. Watch ongoing bid-price fragility and reverse-split dilution optics.
